sloka: तदस्त्रं राघवः श्रीमानुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः ।जघान परमास्त्रेण गान्धर्वेण महाद्युतिः ।। ६.१०१.५ ।।
transliteration: tadastraṁ rāghavaḥ śrīmānuttamāstravidāṁ varaḥ ।jaghāna paramāstreṇa gāndharveṇa mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.101.5 ।।

translations.english: Glorious Raghava, who is the best of those proficient in the use of missiles endowed with great splendour, neutralized that missile (of Ravana) with the missile presided over by Gandharvas.
